description: Dyadic Icon Item Level 1 Binds when picked up Unique Relic Totem Classes: Shaman Engrave your chest or robe with the Overload rune: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat. "Learn a new ability after receiving Nature damage 10 times." Added in Season of Discovery. May not be in WoW: Forever.
